A New Standard in Autonomous Coding: GPT-5.2 Codex

OpenAI has introduced the new Codex model, built on the GPT-5.2 architecture, to accelerate software development processes. Featuring more advanced autonomous capabilities compared to previous generations, the system promises high performance, particularly in long-term context management and complex system setups.

The model’s most notable feature is its built-in context compression technology. This allows the overall structure and context of the project to be preserved while analyzing code repositories containing thousands of lines of code. Additionally, with its visual understanding capabilities, it can directly convert technical diagrams and user interface (UI) designs into working code.

The key technical capabilities and performance metrics of GPT-5.2 Codex are as follows:

  • Advanced Terminal Usage: Optimized for Windows environments, the model can autonomously perform system management tasks such as code compilation, server setup, and model training.
  • Benchmark Scores: It achieved a 56.4% success rate on the SWE-Bench Pro test and a 64% success rate on the Terminal-Bench 2.0 test.
  • Cybersecurity Analysis: The model, with enhanced defensive capabilities, demonstrated its effectiveness in code review by identifying three different security vulnerabilities in the React library.

In terms of accessibility, OpenAI has begun rolling out GPT-5.2 Codex—initially for paid ChatGPT users—via the Codex CLI and IDE plugins. For cybersecurity experts, the “Trusted Access” program has been launched.
